review:
A snowy mountain 5x3 with free spins, multipliers and jackpots. Peak scatters on reels one, three and five give nine free spins.

In the bonus, a bonus symbol landing via a wild line win resets the count to three, and a bonus symbol can pay a repeat win when its value matches what triggered the free spins. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
